**Part 1: Loops**
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
for(i in seq_len(20)) {
  j <- i^3
  print(j)
}
  
```

```{r}
for( i in seq_len(5)){
  print(paste(sample(letters, 5, replace = TRUE), collapse=""))
}


```
```{r}
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
nums <- seq_len(5)

break_df <- tibble()
for(i in seq_len(10)){
  item <- sample(breakfast, size = 1)
  num <- sample(nums, size = 1)
  row <- tibble (
    item = item,
    count = num
  )
  break_df <- bind_rows(break_df, row)
}

gt(break_df)
```

**Part 2: Using simulation to understand probability**
```{r}
n_sims <- 1000
n_flower_per_sim <- 200

flowers <- rbinom(
  n = n_sims,
  size = n_flower_per_sim,
  prob = 0.6
)

times_successful <- sum(flowers >= 125)

prob_successful <- times_successful / n_sims
print(prob_successful)

flower_df <- tibble(pollenating_flowers = flowers)

ggplot(flower_df,
       aes(x = pollenating_flowers)) +
  geom_bar()
  theme_minimal()
```
